people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

translations.web: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.”
translations.bsb: But God said to Balaam, “Do not go with them. You are not to curse this people, for they are blessed.”
translations.kjv: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.
translations.asv: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people; for they are blessed.
